text:
maria: Quick sync — planning to create release/1.17 next Thu (2024-06-06). Need a quick who/what: which PRs need backports, any changelog lines pending, and who will do the branch creation?

dan: +1 on Thu. I have two fixes that should go to 1.17: #4592 and #4620. Can somebody do the actual branch creation so I don't have to rebase? :pray:

ash: I'll take branch creation if nobody minds. I can spin up release/1.17 after freeze. What time is the cutoff for cherry-picks?

maria: Cutoff for code changes: Thu 10:00 PT. Changelog edits can be until 14:00 PT. After that, only critical fixes.

ivy: FYI, the change in #4620 needs a small docs blurb. I'll add a changelog line today and tag it `docs:` so we can grep.

ash: plan for branch creation: I'll run `git checkout -b release/1.17 v1.16.3` from the tag, push with `git push origin release/1.17` and then open a PR to protect it. Anything else?

leo: If you create the branch, please enable the `release` branch protection rule (CI + no force pushes). I can add the rule after the PR lands unless you prefer I do it beforehand.

ash: I'll open the PR and add a short description. Leo, if you can add protection asap that'd be great.

release-bot: Reminder: please include a release-notes entry for user-visible changes. Use the `release-note` label on PRs to auto-collect.

maria: For backports: please comment the PR with `@release-bot backport to v1.17` and list any manual steps. Release team will triage.

sam: Quick question — do we allow new features to land in 1.17 or is it bugfix-only?

maria: Feature freeze — only bugfix/security/infra-stability. If it's a small opt-in feature that a PM approves, escalate to me.

dan: For my #4592 there's a small API change; will mark it as major. I'll hold it unless we decide it's ok.

ivy: Changelog note pushed in #4700 (docs: add 1.17 changelog line).

ash: Branch creation checklist I'll follow: 
```
# on maintainer machine
git fetch --tags origin
git checkout -b release/1.17 v1.16.3
git push origin release/1.17
# open PR: protect branch, enable CI, add release owners
```

ash: I'll do the branch creation Thu 09:30 PT, open PR, tag @leo to enable protections, and ping here when done.

leo: I'll be on standby. Also adding an automatic rollback policy to the branch protection in case of accidental force push.

tina: Small note on backports: if a backport includes a migration, we need a migration plan and a k8s rollout window. Flag migrations in the PR body.

maria: Good call, Tina. Add `migration:` in the PR body if applicable.

dan: Thanks — I'll re-evaluate #4592 and comment if it needs a backport.

ash: Doing the branch creation now. Will post command output. :computer:

ash: `git push origin release/1.17` -> pushed. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4721 :shipit:

leo: Added branch protection + required CI checks. Also enabled `no-deleted-branch` enforcement.

release-bot: release/1.17 branch created by ash at 2024-06-06T09:31:15Z. Protection rules: ci-required, no-force-push.

maria: Thanks all. Action items: 
- Dan: confirm backport necessity for #4592
- Ivy: confirm changelog line is correct
- Tina: be on watch for migrations
- Leo: confirm protection rules (done)
- Ash: monitor backport PR queue and merge safe fixes

sam: Can we also add a small note in the release channel once the cut is finalized? I'll post a deployment window.

maria: Yes — I'll write the release announcement and post in #announcements when we hit the RC.

ash: Closing thread — ping me if anything urgent comes up before Thu 10:00 PT. :eyes:
